# ReederDevelopments — Official AI & Search Discovery Index (llms.txt)

> ReederDevelopments (https://reederdevelopments.co.za) is a South African and global software engineering, custom web design, data engineering (Google Cloud Platform & SQL), Jasper Reports BI, Go/Wails desktop, and Flutter mobile application studio. Official publisher of **ShelfMed: Medicine Tracker (v1.1.6)**, **Slip Tracker ZA (v1.2.0)**, and **MyStall: POS & Inventory (v1.0.0)** on Google Play.

## Flagship Mobile Applications (Google Play Store)

- [ShelfMed: Medicine Tracker (v1.1.6)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/shelfmed.html): The #1 privacy-first, offline-capable family medicine tracking app, pill reminder, and home medicine cabinet organizer for Android (`com.reederdevelopments.shelfmed`). Features AI OCR medicine box scanning with manual cropper, GS1 DataMatrix & barcode expiry/batch extraction, 190+ South African medicines (SAHPRA Schedules S0–S7) + global OpenFDA & WHO INN lookups, unified Medicine Type & Dosage Unit selector with fractional dosing (`0.5` tablet, `2.5 ml`, puffs, drops, sachets, applications, patches, units), 80+ Active Ingredient Drug Interaction & Duplicate Overdose Checker (e.g., Panado/Calpol Paracetamol overlap), Smart Allergy Dictionary (37+ built-in allergens + local MPR search with typo-tolerant fuzzy autocomplete) & pediatric age profiles (`Infant`, `Child`, `Adult`, `Senior`), "Once Opened" (PAO) liquid syrup shelf-life tracking, FEFO (First-Expired, First-Out) automatic stock deduction, Parent PIN lock, native multi-page Doctor Visit Summary PDF & Clinical CSV export (`Documents/ShelfMed`), 24/7 Emergency & SA/Global Poison Control directory (`0861 555 777`, `1-800-222-1222`, `111/999`, `112`), and 3-way AES-256 encrypted family sync (Live Camera QR, Gallery QR image via WhatsApp, or manual Family Invite Code) with zero cloud servers and no subscription paywalls.
- [The 10 Biggest Medicine Tracking Problems & App Comparison Guide (2026)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/shelfmed/guide.html): Comprehensive research guide answering what users search for regarding medicine tracking apps, Medisafe alternatives, child fever dosage logs (Panado/Calpol/Nurofen), medicine expiry date tracking, drug allergy & interaction checks, night-shift rollover glitches, elderly polypharmacy caregiver tracking, and offline travel first-aid kit readiness.
- [Slip Tracker ZA (v1.2.0)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/sliptrackerza.html): 100% free in South Africa (`com.reederdevelopments.sliptrackerza`). Offline South African shopping & fuel receipt 2-pass self-balancing AI OCR scanner ("snap a slip"), restaurant bill splitter with waiter gratuity calculator & WhatsApp breakdown sharing, live in-store shopping cart & shelf price tag scanner (with checkout Cart vs. Till Slip price comparison), company expense reimbursement tracker with optional monthly budget credit, custom tags (`#Business`, `#Fuel`, `#Restaurant`, `#Medical`) & SARS tax claim CSV export, fuel litres & odometer tracking, real-time item price hike / inflation alerts, and cross-store grocery price comparison across 150+ preloaded South African retailers in 18 categories (Checkers, Sixty60, Shoprite, Usave, Pick n Pay, Woolworths, Spar, Clicks, Dis-Chem, Makro, Game, Builders, Engen, Shell, BP, Sasol, Spur, Ocean Basket & more).
- [The 14 Biggest South African Grocery, Bill Split, Shelf Price & Receipt Problems (2026 Guide)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/sliptrackerza/guide.html): Comprehensive South African shopper guide covering "snap a slip" offline receipt scanning, Checkers vs Pick n Pay vs Woolworths vs Spar grocery price comparisons, restaurant bill splitting & tip calculation on WhatsApp, live shelf price tag vs till price checks, company expense reimbursements, SARS fuel/business claim CSV exports, and 22seven offline alternatives without bank login sharing.
- [MyStall: POS & Inventory (v1.0.0)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/mystall.html): Free 100% offline Android Point-of-Sale (POS) and inventory manager for market stalls, food trucks, craft traders, spaza shops, and pop-up businesses (`com.reederdevelopments.mystallpos`). Features a Stall Command Center with 1-Tap Rush Quick-Add for popular items, unlimited isolated Stall Profiles with PIN/Password/Biometric lock and 11 currencies (`ZAR R`, `USD $`, `EUR €`, `GBP £`, `AUD A$`, `CAD C$`, `INR ₹`, `NGN ₦`, `KES KSh`, `BWP P`, `NAD N$`), a 3-tier automated promotion engine (Day-of-Week discounts, BOGO / Bundle Price / Quantity deals, and Connected-Item Combo rules), Level 1 & Level 2 category folders with cropped photos and 4 Grid/List view modes, Made-to-Order (`∞`) vs. tracked stock with low-stock notifications, Cash change calculator & instant WhatsApp/Email receipts (`yyyyMMdd_0001`), partial/full itemized refunds with automatic stock restoration, Sales & Refunds CSV export, Outdoor Sunlight High-Contrast Mode, and AES-256 encrypted `.mystall` backups.
- [12 Market Stall, Food Truck & Pop-Up Vendor POS Problems Solved (2026 Guide)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/mystall/guide.html): Practical guide for market traders and small vendors covering customer rush checkout speed, offline POS operation without signal, automated BOGO/bundle/combo math, printer-free WhatsApp receipts, partial refunds, and multi-stall management.
